title: Replication package for: A Capability-Based Reference Architecture for Enterprise AI Platforms
description: Evidence and reproduction steps for the paper's derivation and evaluation claims: requirements traceability, alternative decompositions, the 40-cell commercial-platform evidence matrix (Table 4), the 36-cell documentary triangulation (Table 5), the falsification assessment, and the frozen protocol, interface inventories, results and negative control of the technology-substitution experiment.
